description: Database/schema lifecycle: CREATE|ALTER|DROP DATABASE|SCHEMA synonyms, conditional clauses, default attributes (charset/collation/encryption), TiDB placement binding, system/business protection and ordered-state namespace facts (issue #96). Anchors: MySQL 5.7.44 / 8.0.46 / 8.4.10, TiDB v8.5.0. T17-R1: INE arm-convergence (5.7-refused encryption, unproven version, TiDB placement), vendor-refused and unproven unextracted schema options, downstream table binding.
